Membership Price Guide About Us Why We are the Best? Learn more about our clinic and doctors and why they are trusted by so many families in our community. Welcome to NuMi Aesthetics Led by board-certified physician Sazia Nowrin, MD, at NuMi Aesthetics, our skilled professionals provide safe and effective procedures—from injectables and anti-aging treatments to body sculpting, skin rejuvenation, and weight management—to help you achieve your beauty goals and confidence. Where Beauty Meets Wellness NuMi Aesthetics treats all genders and ethnicities of ages over 18, customizing treatments rendered after detailed consultation and patients’ unique needs. We proudly serve entire southern New Hampshire NH including Windham, Salem, and Londonderry as well as northern Massachusetts including Andover, Methuen, and Dracut.
